subject: NimbleWorks onboarding — Additional insurance & subcontractor coverage questions
content:
From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@nimbleworks.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@nimbleworks.com
Date: Sun, 21 Nov 2027 15:07:00 -0800
Subject: Initial onboarding docs — COI and subcontractor coverage

Hi Grace,

Thanks for the warm welcome last week. We're excited to get NimbleWorks set up as a Redwood vendor. Per your procurement checklist, attached is our initial COI. A couple of quick questions came up while preparing paperwork:

- Our policy lists a primary insured and several subcontractors — does Redwood require an endorsement naming Redwood as Additional Insured, or is the COI sufficient for activation?
- NimbleWorks works with a small set of subcontractors on a per-project basis. Do you need the full subcontractor roster now, or can we provide it when a particular subcontractor will be used on a Redwood project?

I've attached: nimbleworks_COI.pdf and a working subcontractor_list.xlsx (internal names redacted for now).

If you prefer, we can also route a single-file endorsement from our broker.

Best,
Elena Rossi
Contracts Manager
NimbleWorks
[Attachment: nimbleworks_COI.pdf (pdf), nimbleworks_subcontractor_list.xlsx (xlsx)]

---

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@nimbleworks.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Mon, 22 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial onboarding docs — COI and subcontractor coverage

Hi Elena — thank you for sending these over and for the clear summary. Quick answers and next steps below so we can unblock PO creation: 

1) Additional Insured endorsement: Our standard procurement policy requires Redwood Inc. to be listed as Additional Insured for Commercial General Liability (GL) when the vendor performs services on our behalf or on Redwood premises. A COI alone is often accepted temporarily, but before we issue a purchase order we need either:
   - A GL endorsement listing "Redwood Inference, its officers, employees and agents" as Additional Insured (CG 20 10 or equivalent), or
   - A signed exception approved by Procurement for cloud-only vendors (requires legal sign-off).

2) Subcontractor roster: For activation we need a high-level declaration of whether subcontractors will be used and the categories of services they provide. We do NOT require full names for every subcontractor upfront; however, when a subcontractor will access Redwood systems or handle customer data, we require an updated subcontractor list with COIs/endorsements for those specific parties.

3) Waiver of subrogation & primary/secondary wording: Please confirm whether your insurer is willing to endorse Waiver of Subrogation in favor of Redwood for the relevant policies (GL and Employers' Liability) — that speeds approval. Also confirm if your policy is primary and non-contributory or if you need an endorsement.

4) Next items for PO issuance:
   - Updated GL endorsement PDF naming Redwood as Additional Insured (preferred) OR broker confirmation an endorsement can be issued upon request.
   - Completed W-9 (for US vendors) or equivalent tax form.
   - Confirmation on whether any subcontractor will require system access (if yes, identify which ones).

Attached is a short template we ask partners to use for endorsement wording (redwood_sample_endorsement.txt). If it's easier, loop in your broker and we can coordinate directly.

I'll ask Procurement to provision a conditional PO (valid for 30 days) once we have broker confirmation — that should get you started on work that doesn't involve regulated customer data.

Thanks,
Grace O'Connor
Senior Procurement Manager
Redwood Inference
[Attachment: redwood_sample_endorsement.txt (txt)]

---

From: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@nimbleworks.com>
To: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
Cc: contracts@nimbleworks.com
Date: Tue, 23 Nov 2027 11:45:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial onboarding docs — COI and subcontractor coverage

Hi Grace — appreciate the clarity. Quick clarifications from our side: 

- Our broker confirms they can issue an Additional Insured endorsement; they asked for Redwood's full legal name and the exact wording you'd like listed. We can send the endorsement within 2–3 business days once we have the precise language.
- Waiver of subrogation: broker says this will require carrier approval but is typically granted; they can request it now.
- Subcontractors: none of our current subcontractors will access Redwood customer data. We'll provide the full subcontractor roster once a PO is approved for a project that requires them.

We'll upload the W-9 and broker contact details to your DocuSign PO link and send the endorsement PDF as soon as it's issued.

Elena

---

From: Grace O'Connor <grace@redwood.com>
To: Elena Rossi <elena.rossi@nimbleworks.com>
Cc: Lauren Bishop <lauren@redwood.com>, Priyom Das <priyom@redwood.com>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 24 Nov 2027 10:20:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Initial onboarding docs — COI and subcontractor coverage

Great — thanks Elena, that's perfect. Two small follow-ups: 

- Endorsement wording: please use this exact clause when requesting the endorsement from your broker: "Redwood Inference LLC, its officers, directors, employees and agents" to be listed as Additional Insured under CG 20 10 or equivalent.
- For the waiver of subrogation, mark the request as "in favor of Redwood Inference LLC". If carrier approval is delayed, the conditional PO will be issued with a 30-day window to deliver the formal endorsement.

Procurement will create the conditional PO (NW-2027-1121) and route the DocuSign link to the contact on file. Once we receive the endorsement PDF and W-9, we'll finalize the PO and move the vendor from "Onboarding - provisional" to "Active" in our vendor registry.

I'll check back if Legal needs additional language.

Thanks again — looking forward to working together.

Warmly,
Grace

[DocuSign PO link: https://www.docusign.com/en/documents/NW-PO-20271121]
